g.title: ICH_QSP
g.text: Spontaneous Intracerebral Haemorrhage (ICH) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Bleeding rate = driving pressure × hemostatic incompetence | Outcome = mass effect ⊕ heme-iron toxicity | MAP enters twice with opposite sign (CPP = MAP − ICP)
